newsitem.title: USA: U.S. domestic auto sales up 3.6 pct Nov 1-10 - CNW.
newsitem.headline: U.S. domestic auto sales up 3.6 pct Nov 1-10 - CNW.

text.p: U.S. domestic automobile sales increased 3.6 percent in the first 10 days of November compared with the same period a year ago, according to a CNW Marketing/Research auto sales report released on Tuesday.
Domestic car sales slipped to 148,624 in the 10-day survey period from 155,582 in the same period of 1995, CNW said. Import car sales rose to 32,159 from 29,042, CNW said.
Domestic truck sales climbed to 148,421 from 131,164, while import truck sales rose to 6,429 from 6,281, CNW said.
The report said about 35.8 percent of the vehicles were leased, up from 34.8 percent in the same survey period last year.
About 13.23 million vehicles were sold from January through early-November 1996, CNW said.
